page_title: Photo Editor: BeFunky - Free Online Photo Editing & Collage Maker

sources.entry: 15. BeFunky - Photo editing and graphic design.

summary.name: BeFunky
summary.one_liner: BeFunky is a browser-based creative platform for editing photos, making collages, and designing graphics, with AI-assisted editing and batch workflows.
use_cases: Editing and enhancing photos in a browser
Removing backgrounds or unwanted objects from photos
Making photo collages for memories or social posts
Designing social media posts, flyers, and invitations
Applying the same edits across many photos at once
Creating pet portraits and artwork from photos
summary.what_it_does: BeFunky combines a Photo Editor, Collage Maker, and Graphic Designer in one online platform. The Photo Editor handles quick adjustments, object removal, background replacement, and artistic effects. The Collage Maker arranges multiple photos in customizable layouts and templates. The Graphic Designer builds social posts, flyers, invitations, and similar designs from photos, text, and templates. The page describes AI tools for background removal, enhancement, creative transformations, and conversational editing via Smart Edit, plus batch editing across multiple images.
notable: Free plan usable without an account, with Plus and Pro paid tiers for advanced and AI features
Batch editing for applying edits or background removal across many images
Smart Edit lets users describe the edit they want in conversation and refine results
Development of online photo editing tools since 2007
caveats: Advanced editing, AI tools, exclusive effects and batch workflows require Plus or Pro subscription (Pro includes batch editing and extra AI credits)
AI features are credit-limited on higher-volume use, per the page's note on additional AI credits
Mobile and tablet access is noted, but the page does not detail feature parity across devices
